questions.prompt: Which description best brings together the purposes of the new building?
questions.promptZh: 哪项最能综合概括新建筑的用途？
options: A base for reserve research and school accommodation.
A centre for coastal tourism and visitor accommodation.
A centre for community events and contractor training.
A base for reserve management and community learning.
questions.explanationZh: 第3句明确管理基地和公众了解海岸两项用途，第8—9句补充社区学习活动；其余选项混入未提到的用途。

questions.prompt: Which activity is included in the planned programme?
options: Gardening for wildlife and growing food.
Growing food and training nature tour guides.
Training nature tour guides and restoring boats.
Restoring boats and gardening for wildlife.
questions.explanationZh: 第9句同时列出种植食物及有利于野生生物的园艺；培训自然导览员与修复船只都未在计划中出现。每项都包含两个活动，须核对整个组合。

questions.prompt: Why will people find part of the car park blocked off?
questions.promptZh: 为什么人们会发现停车场的一部分被围挡？
options: It is being used for the planned community events.
It is being closed as part of the construction period.
It is being turned into a wildlife-friendly garden.
It is being reserved for the first school programme.
questions.explanationZh: 第11—12句说明仍处施工阶段，施工期间部分停车场被围挡；不是已开放活动的停车安排。

questions.prompt: Which access arrangements are described for the construction period?
questions.promptZh: 文章如何描述施工期间的通行安排？
options: The development site stays open, but the whole car park closes.
The development site closes, but the whole car park stays open.
The development site and part of the car park remain closed.
The development site and car park close only during school visits.
questions.explanationZh: 第12句明确区分两个范围：整个项目工地对公众关闭，公共停车场则只有一部分被围挡；第13句补充用标识引导安全通行。不是整个停车场关闭，也没有仅学校来访时关闭的限制。
